Pesticide / soil-testing licences where the role needs them

Type rating for the aircraft you will fly

SHRM / HRCI or a labour-law short course for people roles

TESOL / CELTA if you train language or debate
Defence: NDA / CDS / AFCAT as the entry exam you actually sit
Design: Google UX Design Certificate (strong for UI/UX)

Economics: NISM / FRM Part I if you pivot to markets
R programming or data-analytics certificates help applied roles
Education: RCI credentials if you work in special education
Energy: SPE membership and short industry courses
Engineering: ESE / state engineering services where relevant
AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or PLC certificates matching the branch
Fashion: CGD / pattern-CAD short courses (Gerber, Lectra, Optitex)

Finance: CFA Level I (markets and research roles)
Digital banking / FinTech certificates for specialist PO tracks
Healthcare: State council / NMC / INC registration for the profession
Specialty fellowships or council-recognised add-on certificates
Hospitality: Certified Hospitality Administrator or equivalent later
Language and sommelier short courses for luxury properties
Law: Company-law / CS electives or diploma for in-house work
CIPP or a privacy certificate if you do data / tech law
Maritime: Medicals kept current under DGS rules
Media: Adobe Premiere / After Effects professional certificates

Mining: DGMS certificates of competency (mines manager / surveyor)
Mine-safety and blasting licences as the role requires
Performing arts: NSD / FTII / university diplomas where they fit the craft
Trinity / ABRSM (music) or recognised dance diplomas
Showreel, workshops, and union cards often matter more
Public service: UPSC CSE or the state PSC you are targeting
CAPF / state police exams for uniformed tracks

Science: CSIR NET / GATE in the relevant paper
Good Clinical Practice if you work in trials
Instrument or GLP short courses for industry labs

ACE / NASM / ACSM for fitness trainers
Yoga Alliance or AYUSH-recognised yoga certification
